objective: Verify system stability, repair vitest worker pool configuration for integration tests, and record delivery evidence
findings: Vitest default worker threads disable process.chdir(), causing integration tests in tests/integration/core.test.ts to fail with ERR_WORKER_UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION.
Setting pool: 'forks' in vitest.config.ts enables child process forks which support process.chdir().
decisions: Configured pool: 'forks' in vitest.config.ts to ensure integration tests isolated in temporary directories execute cleanly without worker thread limitations.
